description: A square upholstered ottoman with a tufted top. The tufting creates four distinct indentations on the top surface, adding a classic touch. The sides of the ottoman are also upholstered and appear to be a single piece, creating a seamless look. The material has a subtle textured grain, resembling leather or a similar synthetic upholstery. It sits on a plain, light gray background, with soft lighting that highlights the contours and texture of the object.
